dct_description_sm: One zip file containing metadata and list of geocoordinate site locations (1 Excel file) and a folder of 787 Excel files containing the CPT(z) data of each site.    Soil type: Used as a flag for identification of liquefiable layers; empty (no text) for liquefiable layers (sand, sandy, Ic < 2.6) or 'C' for non-liquefiable layers (silt, clay, Ic > 2.6).    z(m): Depth of measurement in meters.    qc (kpa): cone tip resistance measurement in kPa.    fs (kpa): sleeve friction measurement in kPa.    u2 (kpa): pore pressure measurement in kPa.    FC(%)_lab: fines content in percentage determined from laboratory grain sieve analysis or nearby borehole information.

Cone penetration testing (CPT) database of the Metro Vancouver seismic microzonation mapping project's (MVSMMP) geodatabase for western Metro Vancouver. The data is compiled from open-source datasets and was shared by 24 agencies, organizations, and/or consultants and are anonymized. Development of the MVSMMP geodatabase and its (sub)databases are detailed in Adhikari (2024),  https://ir.lib.uwo.ca/etd/9949.
